main_text.l: imam Theologiæ partem ab eo gravissi-
mè tractatam, & non ex more Scholasti-
corum, qvi temere & sine judicio de re-
nihilqve edunt in Theologiam præter so-
phismata & argutias, qvæ viros doctos ad
incitent: Hacte-nus de iis, qvæ Morinus publici
complures alios in lucem edere libros si-
bi propositum fuisse, & cùm hæc scribe-
rundam Morini, qvæ nondum edita sunt;
{z} Index opusc. posthum. Mor. Edit, Anno 1675.

page.notes: The reference mark in the text is printed as a parenthesised z, "(z)"; it is given here as {z}, and the footnote carries the same mark. "tulimns" is printed as shown (probable printing error for "tulimus"). The "De" at the lower right is a catchword. The dark blot near "edere" and the scanner edge on the right are not printed text.
